name: Srednetyungskoye GCF-Tamalakan Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: no sourced length for this segment (designer portfolio says 230 km DN300-100; 147 km DN325 figure unverified; other sources say 130 km); also no concrete step for this segment yet beyond design start
researcher_notes: Not P6710 (Srednetyungskoye-Nakyn, 160 km, Nyurbinsky/Nakyn ore field, construction): this is the Srednetyungskoye GKM to Tamalakan (Verkhnevilyuysky district, left bank Vilyuy) trunk, sponsor AO Sakhatransneftegaz. Yk24 2025-02-19 (Yakutia head statement): design of main gas pipeline Srednetyungskoye GKM-Tamalakan begins 2025; first stage is a separate 32 km Tamalakan-Dyullyukyu trunk (Tamalakan-Dyullyukyu concession signed 2026-09-03 at EEF, works from Oct 2026, gas to Dyullyukyu Aug 2028, per YakutiaMedia). Yakutgazproekt (designer) portfolio lists the Srednetyungskoye GKM-Tamalakan trunk at 230 km DN300-100, Vilyuy and Tyung crossings, 8 AGRS - single corporate portfolio page, not an official project document, may predate/differ from current design. Same Yk24 article mentions a branch from Onkhoy toward Nyurbinsky district, possibly overlapping the P6710 corridor; adjudicate when the route is published. Monitor for: published design length, construction concession for the Srednetyungskoye-Tamalakan leg, and the 32 km Tamalakan-Dyullyukyu segment (sourced 32 km, concession signed, sponsor identified but it is >=25 km so could be a separate new_row candidate: endpoints Tamalakan-Dyullyukyu, Verkhnevilyuysky, Sakha; status construction pending Oct 2026 start -> proposed; refs yk24 + yakutiamedia). Confidence low for the candidate as named.
